title: Friends, celebrations and fashion
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a barátaidról, az ünnepekről, a divatról és a vásárlásról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, és indokold, amit mondasz.

questions.q: Tell me about your best friend. How did you meet?
followUps: What do you like most about him or her?

questions.q: What do you and your friends usually do when you meet?
What makes a good friend, in your opinion?
Which family celebration do you like best? Why?
followUps: How does your family celebrate it?

questions.q: How did you celebrate your last birthday?
Do you get on well with older people, for example your neighbours or your friends' parents?
Is fashion important to you? What kind of clothes do you like wearing?
followUps: Where do you usually buy your clothes?

questions.q: Do you prefer shopping alone or with friends? Why?
What do teenagers in Hungary often argue about with their parents?

usefulPhrases.en: We've known each other since primary school.
